name: Direct API monetization layer for indie API sellers leaving marketplace fees
buyer: Solo developer or tiny team selling a data, scraping or AI API on Rapid (RapidAPI) or similar marketplaces and earning roughly $500-$5,000/month
pain: A 25% marketplace cut, slow PayPal payouts, and no ownership of the customer relationship.
wedge: Metering-only layer with Stripe-connected keys and credit flow, set up in under 30 minutes, at a flat ~$29/mo. It would need a niche such as Stripe-native credit top-ups or per-call micropayments for AI agents, because ReqKey already sells a flat fee.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Flat monthly fee for a metering-only layer on top of the seller's own Stripe account, with no revenue share.
scan1Edge.falsifier: ReqKey already offers about $25 flat. If sellers will not leave a marketplace that supplies buyers, or the niche (agent micropayments, credit top-ups) shows no paying demand, there is no edge.
scan1Edge.unit: USD per month in platform fees at $2,000/month of API revenue

substitutesNoted.name: ReqKey
substitutesNoted.price_point: $25/mo flat Pro at $2,000/mo revenue (vendor claim); free for 5M requests/month

substitutesNoted.price_point: free to list, no commission, no billing

substitutesNoted.name: AWS Marketplace
substitutesNoted.price_point: 3% for SaaS listing, 20% for server-based products

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: ESTIMATE from research notes: margin ~85%. Assumes the seller already has customers. Processor fees are charged by the seller's own payment processor.

majorUncertainty: Whether sellers will leave marketplaces that bring them buyers, and whether any niche beyond ReqKey's existing flat-fee offer has paying demand.
unknowns: Named public complaints from sellers about the 25% fee (none found)
Paying demand for per-call micropayments for AI agents
ReqKey's real traction and verified pricing (vendor claim)
How a solo entrant would reach sellers
Whether Apify scraper earnings figures are accurate
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Depends on Stripe or another payment processor. Taking payments brings processor and sales-tax rules, so a metering-only design is safer. The metering layer sits in the request path, so uptime matters.
